tasks.brief: Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/index.html only. Add exactly four data-testid attributes to existing elements. Do not change any other HTML, CSS, JS, or structure. No new elements, no removed elements, no attribute value changes except adding the specified testids. Behavioral specification: 1. Locate the textarea with id="system-prompt-input" and add data-testid="system-prompt-input". 2. Locate the button with id="settings-save" and add data-testid="settings-save". 3. Locate the button with id="settings-cancel" and add data-testid="settings-cancel". 4. Locate the div with id="status-strip" and add data-testid="status-strip". Acceptance condition: The file contains exactly these four attributes with these exact values. The grep smoke_check in contracts.json passes.

Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/app.js only. Add exactly three setAttribute calls. Do not change any other logic, behavior, or structure. No new functions, no removed code, no behavioral changes. Behavioral specification: 1. In the renderSidebar function, after creating the rename button element (renBtn), add: renBtn.setAttribute('data-testid', 'thread-rename-btn'); 2. In the renderSidebar function, after creating the delete button element (delBtn), add: delBtn.setAttribute('data-testid', 'thread-delete-btn'); 3. In the startRename function, after creating the inline input element (inp), add: inp.setAttribute('data-testid', 'thread-rename-input'); Acceptance condition: The file contains exactly these three setAttribute lines with these exact arguments. All existing tests pass.
